title: Deliberately public route is allowed; the internal route is denied by the operator's custom route rule
note: The published hardened stack has NO first-class route allowlist/denylist, so the route policy here is operator-supplied (a declarative path-prefix deny rule authored in this fixture — the permission intent) and the gateway therefore runs with securityProfile "custom", not "hardened". That trade-off is part of the claim: the public route's allow is the no-rule-hit default; the internal route is denied solely by the operator's rule. Recording this pair also registers the upstream gap (a route-policy rule factory would let this pair run under the hardened stack).
